rules.conflictOrdinance: F.S. ch. 112 part III (Code of Ethics for Public Officers and Employees), incl. 112.313 (standards of conduct) and 112.3144 (Form 6 full and public disclosure). https://www.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0100-0199/0112/0112PartIIIContentsIndex.html
rules.abstentionRule: F.S. 112.3143(2): a state public officer may vote on a measure that inures to his or her special private gain but must, within 15 days after the vote, file a memorandum (Form 8A) disclosing the interest. Legislators follow House Rule 3.1 / Senate Rule 1.39 (state the conflict; may abstain). https://www.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0100-0199/0112/Sections/0112.3143.html
rules.ethicsBody: Florida Commission on Ethics (https://ethics.state.fl.us/); House and Senate ethics committees for legislators.

notes: Florida House and Senate members and Cabinet officers file CE Form 6 (full and public disclosure, F.S. 112.3144). Forms read 2026-10-23 from Florida COE EFDMS through its public JSON endpoints (/api/PublicFiling/SearchPublicFilers and /api/PublicFiling/SearchFilingHistory) and the filing PDFs (/Report/GetFormContent?filingId=<id>, viewable at /Report/PrintForm/?filingId=<id>). Where a filer elected to attach a federal tax return instead of listing income (Porras, Garcia), income sources were read from the attached return. Sunbiz rows as for city files. Byron Donalds is handled separately.
